sources: https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/conditions.htm (alerts, read in a browser; beach access updated October 21)
https://www.ncdot.gov/news/press-releases/Pages/default.aspx (read in a browser; latest Hatteras-Ocracoke release October 16, 2026)

values.note: After the mid-October 2026 storm the NPS alert names only Cape Point and Frisco as closed; Ocracoke is listed 'Open year round' and recreation.gov sells its sites from 2026-10-22 on. Island access is by ferry only; check NCDOT ferry and NC 12 status before going.

status.source: https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/conditions.htm (alert 'Cape Point & Frisco campgrounds and several ORV ramps remain closed'; no Ocracoke closure) + https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (Ocracoke: 'Open year round') + recreation.gov availability (Available/Reserved from 2026-10-22), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (Campground Overviews table, Ocracoke: 'Open year round'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (Ocracoke 'Hook-ups? No'; 'Electricity and water are available at 47 camping sites at Oregon Inlet Campground. There are currently no utility connections at the other three campgrounds.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 136 sites, all back-in on sandy soil, most taking 30-38 ft. Everything must fit on the site pad: an RV over 25 ft may have to park a second vehicle in the auxiliary lot outside the campground. Up to two vehicles and six people per site. No shade.

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (Ocracoke: 136 sites) + RIDB catalog for 232504 (Max Vehicle Length 24-48, Driveway Entry Back-In on 135 of 136) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232504 ('If you have a large RV over 25 feet, you may have to park your second vehicle in the auxiliary parking area', 'There are no shaded sites'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232504 ('Flush toilets, drinking water, cold showers, and grills are all provided') + https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm ('Frisco, Cape Point and Ocracoke have unheated showers'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Run by the NPS (recreation.gov: not commercially managed). All sites are booked on recreation.gov, same-day included; walk-ups pay online or at 877-444-6777, rangers take no payment. Stays are limited to 14 days from Easter Sunday to the Sunday after Thanksgiving and 30 days in total over the winter.

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm ('Reservations and payments for campsites ... can only be made online at www.recreation.gov', 'Walk-ups (same day) reservations are permitted; however, campers will need to make payment online ... Rangers are not able to take any form of payment') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232504 ('Reservations only via recreation.gov'; OVERNIGHT USE LIMITATIONS notice; is_commercially_managed false), read 2026-10-22

summary: NPS and recreation.gov: open (the post-storm alert names only Cape Point and Frisco), year-round, $28 confirmed, no hookups. Added 136 back-in sites to 48 ft, cold showers/flush toilets/water, recreation.gov only (same-day OK, no FCFS), 14-night limit Easter-Thanksgiving. AWH note kept unchanged.
flags: Missing phone: recreation.gov gives (252) 475-9054 for campground questions (8:00-4:30 ET) and 252-928-6671 as the facility phone.

Island access unconfirmed: secondary reports (around October 18-19) said all three Ocracoke ferry routes were suspended in the mid-October storm; NCDOT's newest Hatteras-Ocracoke press release (October 16) only announced the offseason schedule 'pending any impacts from this weekend's weather', and its live ferry status could not be read. The campground itself is not on the NPS closure alert and is selling sites, so status was recorded open; recheck ferry/NC 12 access before relying on it.
